About

Where research-based design meets real classrooms

I'm an instructional designer and Learning & Development specialist based in Leuven, blending creative design, evidence-based methods, and more than ten years of classroom experience.

At KU Leuven's Faculty of Economics and Business, I designed Flourish Abroad, an intercultural learning course for exchange students, building its six complete modules end to end — from learning outcomes to digital activities and LMS delivery on Toledo.

I bring instructional design, learning coordination, stakeholder management and a data-informed approach to every project — creating learning that is engaging, accessible, and made to last.

Student Progression Case Study

Flourish Abroad — Course Website

KU Leuven · Six-module course

The full course website and digital learning environment for Flourish Abroad — six complete modules as a single learning pathway, with intercultural activities and student-centred resources.

Visit project →zippy-stroopwafel-5d58a8.netlify.app

The six modules I built for KU Leuven

01

Cultural Sensitivity

Awareness of cultural difference and self-reflection before going abroad.

02

Intercultural Communication

Communicating across cultures with Erin Meyer's Culture Map.

03

Adaptability

Adjusting to a new academic and social environment.

04

Emotional Readiness

Wellbeing and mindfulness resources for students.

05

Trust & Belonging

Building connection in mobility programmes.

06

Assessment & Reflection

Video quizzes and reflective activities that consolidate learning.
